```{python}
  </thead>
  <tbody>{rows}</tbody>
</table>
"""
display(HTML(html_table))
```

## Route Map

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| error: false
# Always generate a static snapshot of the route; used as the PDF image
# (the HTML output gets an interactive Folium map instead).
import math
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
from staticmap import StaticMap, CircleMarker, Line

map_img = "route-map.png"

def _lon_to_x(lon, zoom):
    return (lon + 180.0) / 360.0 * 2**zoom

def _lat_to_y(lat, zoom):
    lat = max(min(lat, 90), -90)
    r = math.radians(lat)
    return (1.0 - math.log(math.tan(r) + 1 / math.cos(r)) / math.pi) / 2.0 * 2**zoom

m = StaticMap(900, 560, padding_x=40, padding_y=40)

coords = [[s["lon"], s["lat"]] for s in stops]
m.add_line(Line(coords, "#000000", 1))

for s in reversed(stops):
    for color, r in (("#000000", 14),):
        m.add_marker(CircleMarker((s["lon"], s["lat"]), color, r))

# auto-fit zoom + centre so every stop is visible
img = m.render()

# Draw the day number on each marker. Positions replicate staticmap's
# own Web-Mercator projection so the labels land exactly on the markers.
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
try:
    font = ImageFont.truetype("OpenSans-Bold.ttf", 16)
except OSError:
    font = ImageFont.load_default()

for i, s in list(enumerate(stops, 1))[::-1]:
    px = m._x_to_px(_lon_to_x(s["lon"], m.zoom))
    py = m._y_to_px(_lat_to_y(s["lat"], m.zoom))
    tx = str(i)
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), tx, font=font)
    tw, th = bbox[2] - bbox[0], bbox[3] - bbox[1]
    draw.text((px - tw / 2 - bbox[0], py - th / 2 - bbox[1]), tx, fill="white", font=font)

img.save(map_img, format="PNG")
```

```{python}
#| echo: false

from IPython.display import display as _display
import os
import folium

center_lat = sum(s["lat"] for s in stops) / len(stops)
center_lon = sum(s["lon"] for s in stops) / len(stops)

m = folium.Map(location=[center_lat, center_lon], zoom_start=9)

_carto_key = os.environ.get("CARTOKEY", "").strip()
_carto_style = "voyager"
_carto_base = "https://basemaps.cartocdn.com/rastertiles/" + _carto_style + "/{z}/{x}/{y}.png"
if _carto_key:
    _carto_url = _carto_base + "?key=" + _carto_key
else:
    _carto_url = _carto_base

folium.TileLayer(
    tiles=_carto_url,
    name="Positron",
    attr="&copy; OpenStreetMap contributors &copy; CARTO",
).add_to(m)

def _numbered_marker(i, s):
    popup_html = f"""
    <b>Day {i} — {s['location']}</b><br>
    {s['date']}<br>
    <i>{s['accommodation']}</i>
    """
    return folium.Marker(
        location=[s["lat"], s["lon"]],
        popup=popup_html,
        tooltip=f"{s['location']}",
        icon=folium.DivIcon(
            html=f'<div style="background:#000;color:#fff;font-family:Open Sans,sans-serif;'
                 f'font-weight:bold;width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;'
                 f'display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;'
                 f'font-size:14px;">{i}</div>',
            icon_size=(24, 24),
            icon_anchor=(12, 12),
        ),
    )

for i, s in enumerate(stops, 1):
    _numbered_marker(i, s).add_to(m)

# stops 1 and 7 share the same location; re-add marker 1 last so it wins the overlap
if stops and stops[0]["lon"] == stops[-1]["lon"] and stops[0]["lat"] == stops[-1]["lat"]:
    _numbered_marker(1, stops[0]).add_to(m)

folium.PolyLine(
    [[s["lat"], s["lon"]] for s in stops],
    color="#2c3e50", weight=2, dash_array="10",
).add_to(m)

# Only the HTML output shows the interactive map; other formats use the
# static PNG generated above, so suppress Folium output here for them.
import json
def _target_format():
    info_path = __import__("os").environ.get("QUARTO_EXECUTE_INFO")
    if info_path:
        try:
            return json.load(open(info_path))["format"]["pandoc"]["to"]
        except Exception:
            return None
    return None

if _target_format() in (None, "html"):
    _display(m)
else:
    _ = None
```
